subject: Mismatch on marketplace usage IDs impacting Sep payouts — reconciliation plan
messages:
From: redpay-billing@awsmarketplace.com
To: aisha_rahman@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 10 Oct 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sep marketplace usage export vs invoice — apparent unallocated usage IDs

Hi Aisha,

We're seeing a mismatch between the usage IDs reported on the Sep 2029 usage export and the invoice we generated for RedPay. Specifically, ~1,200 usage lines from the usage-export (attached) do not map to any invoice line in our payout system; the amounts are small individually but sum to a materially different payout for Sep.

Can someone on your side confirm if RedPay did any post-processing or aggregation of usage IDs before submitting metering records? If you have an internal reconciliation mapping (usage ID -> internal order or entitlement ID), please share it so we can correlate.

Attached: usage-export-2029-09.csv (CSV, 827KB)

We opened internal ticket BILL-5123 and linked it to your account. Next steps from our side: we can run a delta aggregation if you provide mapping, or we can schedule a ledger replay but that takes ~48-72 hours and will hold the Oct payout.

Please advise preferred approach — quick mapping vs ledger replay.

Thanks,
Sharon Lim
Marketplace Billing Ops — AWS Marketplace
redpay-billing@awsmarketplace.com

--
Attachment: usage-export-2029-09.csv (CSV)
From: aisha_rahman@redwood.com
To: redpay-billing@awsmarketplace.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 11 Oct 2029 11:30:45 -0700
Subject: Re: Sep marketplace usage export vs invoice — apparent unallocated usage IDs

Sharon — thanks for the heads up and the CSV. I pulled this into our billing team for a quick look. A few quick notes:

- We performed an internal entitlement consolidation for RedPay on 2029-09-29 where multiple usage IDs were merged under consolidated orders for reporting. That could explain the missing 1,200 line items.
- I don't think Redwood performed any post-submission changes to the usage IDs you received, but RedPay's seller-side mapping may differ.

I'm attaching our reconciliation-matrix-template.xlsx with two sample mappings from the RedPay support logs (internal order -> marketplace usage_id). If you can confirm whether your usage-export contains the original raw usage_id column or a post-aggregation id, we can align quickly.

Preferred approach: if you can run a delta aggregation against the raw usage_id file we provided, we'll validate mappings on our end and avoid the ledger replay. If you need a replay, please call that out and we'll coordinate impact windows.

CC'ing Ben for ledger/finance impact and Marissa for tax/VAT implications.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Senior Manager, Revenue Ops — Redwood Inference
aisha_rahman@redwood.com
Office: +1 415 555 0198

--
Attachment: reconciliation-matrix-template.xlsx (XLSX)
From: redpay-billing@awsmarketplace.com
To: aisha_rahman@redwood.com
Cc: payments-portal@redpay.io
Date: Sun, 13 Oct 2029 09:05:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Sep marketplace usage export vs invoice — apparent unallocated usage IDs

Thanks Aisha — that helps. A couple clarifications from our side:

- The CSV we attached in the original note is the raw ingestion export (pre-pricing). Column headers include usage_id, product_sku, report_timestamp, quantity, and buyer_tenant.
- Your matrix template sample was useful; we can run a mapping job that attempts to match usage_id -> internal_order, then produce a reconciliation report. That job will be non-destructive and should complete within our SLA window (24h) if the mapping is straightforward.

One caveat: if your consolidation removed the original usage_id values (e.g., replaced them with consolidated_order_id), we will need the historical mapping file from RedPay support. Can the seller provide that? If not, we may need the ledger replay.

I've created a support ticket for this (BILL-5123) and uploaded the raw CSV and our initial diff. Link: https://redpay.atlassian.net/browse/BILL-5123.

Regards,
Sharon Lim
Marketplace Billing Ops — AWS Marketplace

--
Attachment: invoice-202909-redpay.pdf (PDF)
From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: redpay-billing@awsmarketplace.com, aisha_rahman@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 15 Oct 2029 14:22:33 -0700
Subject: Proposed reconciliation matrix and non-prod replay window

Sharon / team — looping in finance ops. Quick proposal to accelerate:

1) You run the mapping job against the raw CSV and return a reconciliation report in the matrix format Aisha shared. We will run an internal verification against RedPay seller logs within 24 hours.
2) If the mapping job yields >5% unmatched lines, schedule a non-production ledger replay for Sep in your sandbox to validate whether replay would correct the discrepancy. We prefer sandbox validation before any production ledger replay.
3) Tax/VAT check: Marissa, please confirm whether small-dollar differences could change VAT withholding or reporting thresholds for RedPay in the EU.

Action items:
- Sharon: kick the mapping job and share the reconciliation report by EOD 2029-10-16.
- RedPay seller support: if you have historical mapping, upload to the Jira BILL-5123.
- Redwood: Ben will run a fast verification and escalate if we see systemic aggregation differences.

Attachment: proposed-recon-matrix-sample.xlsx (stub)

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Director, Finance Operations — Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

From: aisha_rahman@redwood.com
To: redpay-billing@awsmarketplace.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 18 Oct 2029 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sep marketplace usage export vs invoice — apparent unallocated usage IDs

Everyone — quick status and agreed next steps. Great progress on this thread, thanks.

Summary of what we confirmed:
- AWS will run the mapping job against the raw Sep export and publish a reconciliation report (matrix) into BILL-5123 by EOD 2029-10-16.
- Redwood will verify against RedPay seller logs and update the Jira with any historical mappings.
- If unmatched lines exceed 5%, we'll perform a sandbox ledger replay before considering production replay.

Open items:
- RedPay seller support to upload their historical mapping or confirm they never emitted original usage_id values (deadline: 2029-10-17).
- Marissa to confirm VAT threshold impact by 2029-10-18.

I'll mark this P0 for finance and stay on standby for any additional evidence you need. If we get the reconciliation matrix and RedPay mapping, we should be able to settle the Sep payout without delaying Oct.

Thanks all — speak soon.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
